generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions applicable as per Tender Notification

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed Building construction/civil work of value not less than Rupees 2.75 lakhs (usually 50% of the amount of contract/estimate cost) as a prime contractor.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate as Prime Contractor should be obtained from forest divisions duly signed by an officer not below the rank of DCF/equivalent officer

technicalCriterionList.description: Achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 11.01 lakhs (usually double the work estimate cost)

Liquid assets and / or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rupees 1.65 lakhs (usually 30% of the amount of contract/estimate cost) for work costing. (Credit lines/letter of credit certificate from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc
Forest Contractor Registration Certificate in O/o Deputy Conservator of Forests Malai Mahadeshwara Wildlife Division, Kollegal/any other division/PWD Class 1 to Class-IV for the year 2026-27
Audited balance sheet for last three financial years (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) with copies of Income Tax returns & balance sheet statement filed.
